name: Catastro Bogotá
body: HSTS, nosniff, framing limited to its origin, GA4 through Tag Manager, and a declared language. But none of the 20 pages read has a meta description, so Google and AI answers write their own.
lesson: Write a one-sentence description for each key page: what it offers and who it's for, under 155 characters.
summary: www.catastrobogota.gov.co scores 74 out of 100 (C). 2 checks fail now, 26 are at risk, and 16 pass. Fix first: 102 form controls have no label.

fix.title: 102 form controls have no label
fix.evidence: On /, /transparencia-y-acceso-a-la-informacion-publica, /atencion-y-servicios-a-la-ciudadania/tramites, /atencion-y-servicios-a-la-ciudadania/Catia and 16 more. Screen readers announce them as an unnamed field.
fix.fix: Pair each control with <label for>, wrap it in a label, or add aria-label.

fix.title: 16 pages name another URL as canonical
fix.fix: Make each page's canonical point at itself unless it is a real duplicate.

fix.title: 20 pages have no meta description
fix.evidence: /, /transparencia-y-acceso-a-la-informacion-publica, /atencion-y-servicios-a-la-ciudadania/tramites, /atencion-y-servicios-a-la-ciudadania/Catia and 16 more. Google and AI answers then write their own snippet from whatever text they find.
fix.fix: Write a 50 to 160 character description for each page that says what a reader gets.

fix.title: No content security policy
fix.evidence: content-security-policy was absent on the start page. Missing on all 20 pages read. Injected scripts are not limited by the browser.
fix.fix: Start with the Report-Only policy in the fix kit, watch the reports for a week, then enforce it.

fix.title: Referrer-Policy is not sent
fix.evidence: Browsers fall back to their default. An explicit policy keeps full URLs from leaking to other sites. Missing on all 20 pages read.

fix.title: Permissions-Policy is not sent
fix.evidence: Embedded content can ask for the camera, microphone, or location. Missing on all 20 pages read.
